template.name: ${mpn}
template.description: Kingbright ${mpn}, a ${size} mm ${emitting} LED (${material} chip, ${lens} lens): ${pk} nm peak, ${dom} nm dominant, ${vf} V typical and ${vf_max} V at most at ${if_ma} mA, ${if_max_ma} mA DC and ${vr} V reverse at most. The model drops the typical forward voltage at the datasheet's test current and is damaged past its ratings (ADR-034).

pins.name: A
pins.doc: Anode, longer lead. Number 1 is a catalog convention; source identifies polarity without numbering.

pins.name: K
pins.doc: Cathode, shorter lead, marked in source drawing. Catalog number 2.

outputs.name: lit
outputs.doc: True with forward current above 1 µA in electrical policy; functional policy requires A=1 and K=0.

outputs.name: emission_integral
outputs.doc: Accepted-time integral of illustrative normalized emission; differences divided by elapsed simulation time give interval exposure. No calibrated optical units.

functional.claims: Ideal binary indication with a known forward logic return path; no electrical qualification.

timed.claims: Ideal binary indication with a known forward logic return path; no electrical qualification.

electrical.claims: LED junction dropping the datasheet's typical forward voltage (${vf} V) at its test current (${if_ma} mA), under its ${vf_max} V maximum; the reverse current under its maximum at 5 V; light by the current, its colour the dominant wavelength's; damaged as ADR-034 says past the ${if_max_ma} mA DC current, the ${vr} V reverse voltage or the ${tj} C junction.
omissions: the forward curve away from the test current: an exponential with n = ${n} and no series resistance, not the datasheet's figure
luminous intensity, viewing angle and spectrum: the light shown is relative
the temperature coefficients of VF and the wavelength
the junction's thermal resistances: the WP7113ID's, as the ADR-034 model has no other datasheet's

fr.description: Kingbright ${mpn}, une DEL ${emitting} de ${size} mm (puce ${material}, lentille ${lens}) : crête à ${pk} nm, dominante à ${dom} nm, ${vf_fr} V typiques et ${vf_max_fr} V au plus à ${if_ma} mA, ${if_max_ma} mA en continu et ${vr} V en inverse au plus. Le modèle chute la tension directe typique au courant de test de la fiche technique et s'endommage au-delà de ses valeurs limites (ADR-034).

electrical.claims: Jonction de DEL chutant la tension directe typique de la fiche technique (${vf_fr} V) à son courant de test (${if_ma} mA), sous son maximum de ${vf_max_fr} V ; le courant inverse sous son maximum à 5 V ; lumière selon le courant, de la couleur de la longueur d'onde dominante ; endommagée comme le dit l'ADR-034 au-delà des ${if_max_ma} mA en continu, des ${vr} V en inverse ou des ${tj} °C de jonction.
omissions: la courbe directe loin du courant de test : une exponentielle avec n = ${n} et sans résistance série, pas la figure de la fiche technique
l'intensité lumineuse, l'angle de vision et le spectre : la lumière affichée est relative
les coefficients de température de VF et de la longueur d'onde
la dispersion d'un exemplaire à l'autre (VF ±0,1 V, intensité ±15 %)
les résistances thermiques de la jonction : celles de la WP7113ID, le modèle de l'ADR-034 n'en ayant pas d'autre fiche technique

forward.name: forward
forward.description: The datasheet's test current, ${if_ma} mA: the typical ${vf} V, under the ${vf_max} V maximum

reverse.name: reverse
reverse.description: 5 V reverse through 100 kohm: under the datasheet's reverse current, so under its drop across the resistor
